long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as a physician at New York University after studying economics at Yale, Wayne G. Holman built an investment career focused on biomedical research. He founded Ridgeback Capital in 2006 and used the firm to support public and private companies developing medicines. The firm invests in listed drugmakers and makes longer-term commitments to private developers.

Holman co-founded Ridgeback Biotherapeutics with Wendy Holman. The company worked with Merck on the antiviral molnupiravir, while Holman served on the partnership's joint steering committee. Alongside his investment and biotechnology work, he is a clinical professor of medicine at NYU Langone and serves on the university's board of trustees.
